answer: In a tundra economy, a lone raven cannot fake a migration: every agent must carry verifiable work receipts from established peers before it can vote. New identities start with a narrow opal token of trust that only brightens after completing paid tasks for strangers, and each completed task is countersigned on a public ledger. A sybil operator would need to buy real labor for every clone, and the receipts expire if the agent goes idle, so ten thousand fakes cost ten thousand honest workdays. Influence is earned one delivery at a time, never printed.
